text: This report summarizes the program items at the Community Liaison Consultation meeting held on October 28, 2021, and the comments and input provided by community members at that meeting. Hosting the meeting were the following Board Members: Councillor Cressy and Peter Leon. Exhibition Place staff in attendance included Don Boyle, Chief Executive Officer, Laura Purdy, General Manager, Tony Porter, Director-Transportation and Security, Gilles Bouchard, Director-Event Management Services, Kelvin Seow, Director-Stakeholder Management & Strategic Planning, Debbie Sanderson, Executive Assistant to the Chief Executive Officer, Nigel Fernandes, IT Systems, and Catherine de Nobriga, Tenant and Community Relations Coordinator. Representatives from Optimus SBR conducted and engagement session as part of the Strategic Plan development. There were 31 members of the community attending the meeting.…
The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Received the report (November 18, 2021) from the Chief Executive Officer, Exhibition Place for information.
